Only you said he had to try a sample first to make sure it was the real thing?"<br />"He was seeing little pink fairies for a month.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and a laughing [[Baasen Ray]] reminisce about the past|<ref name="Honor Among Thieves" />}}
'''Fairies''' were small, imaginary creatures. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] once suffered from hallucinations of [[Color/Legends|pink]] fairies for a whole [[Standard month/Legends|month]], after drinking [[Caskan wolf-snake]] [[Poison/Legends|venom]].<ref name="Honor Among Thieves">''[[Honor Among Thieves]]''</ref>
